class.name: JarMeshSdf
class.brief_description: Signed distance field of a closed triangle mesh, for stamping arbitrary shapes into volumes.
class.description: The mesh is baked into a regular distance grid that is stored in the resource, so saved resources load without baking again. Sampling uses trilinear interpolation and is fast and thread-safe. Inside and outside are decided by ray parity along all three axes with a majority vote, which tolerates small holes and non-manifold spots, but the mesh should be closed. Baking happens automatically the first time a volume or edit uses the field, or press [b]Bake[/b] in the inspector. Combine with [method JarVoxelVolume.edit] to place, rotate and scale the shape.

method.name: bake
method.description: Rebuilds the distance grid from [member mesh]. Runs on the calling thread using the shared worker pool; call it from the main thread.

method.name: is_baked
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a distance grid is available.
